label: Marketing brand voice
description: Propose or apply a brand-voice checklist (tone, do/don't, banned phrases) before external compose or publish steps
propose_guide: Use when NL mentions brand voice, tone of voice, messaging guidelines, or before publishing when brand constraints matter. Produce an Internal checklist: voice attributes, do/don't, banned phrases, required disclaimers, locale. Prefer feeding banned phrases into Owner governor blocked_keywords on write-external connectors (linkedin/publish, mailchimp/campaign, etc.). Optionally take upstream draft copy and return a voice-compliance critique — do not post externally in this skill.
